summary: Two live requests were made to confirm authentication and that the production client accepts real Jev responses. This is a connectivity check, not an evaluation: no frozen task was run and no accuracy is implied.

requests.note: One yes/no question, sent by a standalone script to verify the key and the documented request/response contract.

The production LLMService/JevClient sent the 10 typed interpreter questions for one sample question; every answer passed the production parser and the assembled structured request passed the closed schema. Latency was not captured.

does_not_show: classification accuracy on the frozen tasks
